shots.lighting: TODO. The season look comes first. Channel lighting as built: Ivory studio (set/w3d.js): a procedural soft-box environment through PMREM, a warm key, a cool rim and 2048 px soft shadows (PCFSoftShadowMap).
shots.environment: TODO. Look: Strongly influenced by the Skin School course, not a copy: soft, glowing voxel skin layers on a dark green-black ground, teal as the only accent, small ivory serif captions, and an ASMR voice by Evelyn.
shots.materials: TODO. The season look comes first. Channel materials as built: Skin and tissue as MeshPhysicalMaterial with sheen and clearcoat in each Season 2 scene (set/goose3d.js to set/print3d.js). The helper skinMaterial in set/studio.js (sheen, clearcoat, an attenuation tint through a little transmission; used by ep01 to ep03) approximates subsurface scattering. The channel's own finish in set/w3d.js: 4x MSAA, a 20-tap depth of field, bloom, ACES with the ivory ground exempt. Season 2 renders with --plain, so there is no motion blur.
